# Changelog

## 1.1.0 — 2026-10-08

- Transparent light/dark Hence identity, six-area map, real vault overview and matching social preview.
- Editorial guidance in README, release, maintenance and 56 indices; clearer prose in the four layouts.
- Optional scoped CSS with width, spacing, accents, colors, heading and table controls.
- Optional native interface layer: black/white, accessible green defaults, mode-specific colors, advanced sizes, spacing and corners; native appearance can be restored. Folder icons and indentation guides follow the area palette. One Second Brain settings panel uses visible native color pickers.
- Compact, Balanced and Spacious density presets; a 4px grid for custom dimensions, spacing and corners. Native Appearance retains fonts and content size.
- Five display images in the vault; editable artwork and brand inputs kept in maintenance.
- Style Settings 1.0.9 added with GPL-3.0 license, sources and provenance.
- System light/dark mode and matching Excalidraw drawings/previews.
- Existing plugin code, Helpers, properties, query code, layout logic, icons and Graph area colors preserved.
- The single root license is now LICENSE.md, so Obsidian can resolve its context without an orphan attachment.
- Published v1.0.0 assets remain unchanged.

## 1.0.0

- Six areas for capture, life records, projects, reusable knowledge, planning, and templates.
- Four Templater layouts: NOTE, TASK, DAILY, and WEEKLY; optional dates/priorities and 24 thematic tags.
- Bases collection lists, event views, eight-column Kanban, four deadline lists, ISO journals, and drawings.
- Six bundled community plugins plus Second Brain Helpers.
- Automatic collection context, new-folder indices, inherited icons, and conservative task deletion with session Undo.
- README-first layout, Calendar/Kanban/Graph panels, bookmarks, workspaces, and area colors.

- Target validation: Windows desktop, Obsidian 1.14.4. macOS/Linux remain unvalidated; mobile is outside Helpers support.
- Essential workflows validated in an isolated Windows vault; targeted Helpers compatibility and failure-isolation checks completed.
